steps: Grease a 9-by-13-inch sheet pan and line it with parchment paper.
If using the chocolate topping, melt the chocolate with the heavy cream over a double boiler, stirring frequently, and keep warm.
Heat the ghee in a large saute pan or kadhai.
Add the besan, sugar, cardamom and salt; cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until golden brown with a nutty aroma, 20 to 40 minutes. Do not leave it unattended.
Remove from the heat and immediately spread the mixture onto the prepared pan, smoothing it with an offset spatula.
If topping with chocolate, spread the warm chocolate over it, sprinkle with the pumpkin and sesame seeds, and refrigerate 1 hour to set.
To cut, let the mithai sit at room temperature for 1 hour first, and clean the knife with each cut.

articles.title: Chocolate Phuljhadi: The No-Bake Sparkler Sweet Children Can Make for Diwali
articles.excerpt: Biscuit sticks dipped in melted chocolate and rolled in sprinkles until they look like little sparklers — no baking, ready as soon as the chocolate sets. Slurrp's version makes 12 sticks; a viral biscuit-dough version with edible silver dust is dividing the internet this Diwali.
articles.nri_angle: A five-ingredient, no-bake sweet that children in diaspora kitchens can assemble themselves for Diwali parties — everything on the list is available in a regular US, UK or Gulf supermarket.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

steps: Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil in a heatproof bowl set over a pan of simmering water, stirring until smooth and glossy. Let it cool for a couple of minutes so it is not too runny.
Dip each stick into the chocolate, covering about two-thirds of its length, and tap it gently against the edge of the bowl to let the extra drip off.
Roll the coated part in the sprinkles, nuts or coconut while the chocolate is still wet, then place the stick on a lined tray.
Refrigerate for 15-20 minutes, until the chocolate sets firm.
data_cards.title: Chocolate Phuljhadi (Slurrp)
ingredients: 12 pretzel sticks or long biscuit sticks (like Pocky or breadsticks)
1 cup dark or milk chocolate, chopped
